questions.question: ‘Starvation’ is related to ‘FOOD’ in the same way as ‘Injustice’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
As, ‘Starvation’ is due to lack of ‘Food’.

Similarly,

‘Injustice’ is due to lack of ‘Fairness’.

Hence, ‘Fairness’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A + B means ‘A is husband of B’

A – B means ‘A is son of B’

A × B means ‘A is mother of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is sister of B’

If P – K + D × S ÷ T, then how is P related to T?
questions.solution:
Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree. 

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
Of B

 
 
 

 

Now draw a family tree using the following notations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f6fa33ed7dbc419046adba1d5dc4d3517e3bab8c8717971701cc8a631b2cb5.png] 

Here, P – K + D × S ÷ T means P is son of K, K is husband of D, D is mother of S, S is sister of T.

Family Tree: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cba54e6f069c2a47dd1ff4073102c953bc1c1425ec1c32bbd00571347f41497.png] 

So, P is brother of T.

Hence, ‘Brother’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Which number is on the face opposite the face showing’ 1’ ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23a2e8e1266526d344a8366408fe85cc131be5c8d5b348277be5dc368b7cff58.png]
questions.solution:
Here, 4, 3, 1 and 6 cannot be opposite to 5.

So, 2 must be opposite to 5.

Also, 3 and 6 are not opposite to 4.

So, 1 must be opposite to 4.

Hence, ‘4’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a code language, if ‘MERGER’ is coded as ‘13251872518’, ‘FRIDGE’ is coded as ‘618814725’ then how will ‘HOSTEL’ be coded in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfbcbe8b4268b7a4ecc25f983b74ec52036d0524e85c60be9e915dc19a6ce26f.png] 

Here, the pattern followed is,

In MERGER and FRIDGE, the number representing the vowels are squared.

So, for HOSTEL,

H → 8

O → 15² = 225

S → 19

T → 20

E → 5² = 25

L → 12

So, ‘HOSTEL’ is coded as ‘822519202512’

Hence, ‘822519202512’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Aurangabad

2. Maharashtra

3. World

4. Asia

5. India
questions.solution:
Aurangabad is in Maharashtra.

Maharashtra is in India.

India is in Asia.

Asia is in World.

Hence, ‘1, 2, 5, 4, 3’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a code language, if ‘LUCID’ is coded as ‘33394’, then how will ‘FRANK’ be coded in the same language?

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some phones are keyboards.

All phones are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some keyboards are computers.

II. Some computers are phones.

III. No keyboard is computer

options.text: Only Conclusion I and II follows
Either Conclusion I or III follows

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f274c39ebd5a1499939efa29207cb9251481be072f90f04375d6aa087f73de9.png] 

Conclusion 1: Some keyboards are computers → True

Conclusion 2: Some computers are phones → True

Conclusion 3: No keyboard is computer → False

Hence, ‘Only conclusion I and II follows’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some goats are animals.

No animal is bird.

**Conclusions:**

I. No animal is goat.

II. No bird is goat.

III. Some birds are goat.

IV. Some animals are goats.

options.text: Either Conclusion II or III and conclusion IV follow.
Only Conclusion III and IV follow.
Only Conclusion I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64c1d973b3e1c353e5c2410f2aa4580bd7c3bca070b05f2a80b9e7c014350221.png] 

Conclusion 1: No animal is goat→ False

Conclusion 2: No bird is goat → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 3: Some birds are goat → False (It is possible but not definite)

Conclusion 4: Some animals are goats → True

Hence, ‘Either Conclusion II or III and conclusion IV follow’ is the correct answer.
